questions.question: Fill in the blank: Neither Ram nor his friends _____ present.

questions.question: Select the synonym of Vigilant.

questions.question: Fill in the blank: The train had left _____ I reached the station.

questions.question: Select the synonym of Abandon.

questions.question: Select the antonym of Innocent.

questions.question: Find the error: The weather is more hotter today than yesterday.
